newsitem.title: SENEGAL: Senegal trade deficit forecast to fall in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Senegal trade deficit forecast to fall in 1997.

text.p: Senegal's foreign trade deficit is expected to fall to 141.6 billion CFA ($244 million) in 1997 from 157.2 billion CFA in 1996, according to Ministry of Finance projections released on Thursday.
Official figures show exports of fish and groundnut products rose to 500.8 billion CFA in 1996 from 483 billion in 1995.
Oil imports rose to 664 billion CFA in 1996 from 607.3 billion in 1995. ($1=579 CFA)
